description: "Yeast" by Thomas Henry Huxley is a scientific publication written in the late 19th century. This work explores the fascinating processes involved in the phenomenon of fermentation, focusing particularly on yeast, a ubiquitous organism that plays a crucial role in the transformation of sugars into alcohol and carbon dioxide.
